answer: The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution before the ledger credits work. Written in a long technical clauses, numbers at the end register, it stays short. What survives to the nebula is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The plume lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the whisper is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
